summary: Full E2E regression on the 4 new Support IT features (Excel import/template, Parc assets + Excel export, Accounts parc checkbox + per-user gating, ticket attachment via header modal AND employee page) plus admin dashboard & employee isolation. All backend tests (11/11) and frontend flows pass. Onboarding was already completed (ADMIN user Ales present) so login path is exercised, not the onboarding screen (acceptable per the review).
passed: POST /api/users creates employee with can_access_parc=true/false; GET /api/users reflects flag
POST /api/upload stores file in Emergent object storage; GET /api/files/<path> downloads original bytes with original filename
GET /api/inventory/template returns valid xlsx (headers: Nom, Catégorie, ...)
POST /api/inventory/import parses xlsx and inserts rows (imported=2); items appear in GET /api/inventory
POST /api/tickets with attachment persists attachment object (name,url,size) and ticket is retrievable
UI Admin login (ADMIN): shows Tableau de bord with KPIs and sidebar nav: Tableau de bord, Tous les tickets, Gestion du stock, Parc informatique, Alertes & rappels, Logs de connexion, Comptes & accès
UI Stock: 'Modèle' downloads modele-stock.xlsx; 'Importer Excel' uploads via hidden input and the new row (UI_IMPORT_ITEM) appears in the stock list immediately
UI Parc informatique: tabs Tous/Ordinateur/Imprimante/Tablette present; add-asset-button and export-parc-button visible; export downloads parc-informatique.xlsx

UI Comptes & accès: form has Accès au parc informatique checkbox (account-parc-checkbox); created UITEST1 with checkbox ON → API shows can_access_parc=true; UITEST2 default OFF → can_access_parc=false

UI header '+ Nouveau ticket' modal: title/description/category selection + attachment via ticket-modal-file works; modal closes on submit; ticket appears in Tous les tickets; detail view shows ticket-attachment-link with correct /api/files/ href that downloads the original file
UI Employee UITEST1 (parc=true): sees nav-parc; does NOT see nav-accounts/nav-logs/nav-inventory
UI Employee UITEST2 (parc=false): does NOT see nav-parc (gating works)

UI Employee 'Nouveau ticket' page: fields new-ticket-title/description/category/priority + new-ticket-file upload work; submit creates ticket; detail modal shows attachment link; employee only sees their own ticket in Mes tickets (1 ticket for UITEST2, no other users' tickets)
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: /api/tickets does not validate category/priority against TICKET_CATEGORIES/TICKET_PRIORITIES (frontend-only validation). Low risk but worth adding server-side enum check.
backend/server.py: /api/upload has no file-size/content-type limit — a malicious client could upload large files. Consider a max size (e.g., 10 MB) and MIME allowlist.

backend/server.py: /api/users and /api/assets/users endpoints have no auth check — any client with the URL can list/create/delete users or assets. Fine for an internal preview, but should be gated (even by a shared header) before any real deploy.
backend/server.py: /api/inventory/import does not sanitise category against STOCK_CATEGORIES — imports can introduce arbitrary categories.
frontend: Logout button is icon-only (data-testid=logout-button) — fine for tests, but a visible 'Déconnexion' label or tooltip-visible-on-focus would improve a11y.
test_credentials: ID=ADMIN (name Ales, admin). UITEST1/UITEST2 test users were created and deleted during the run.
seed_data_creation: Transient only: UITEST1 and UITEST2 users + their tickets + UI_IMPORT_ITEM stock row + UI_TICKET_ATTACH2 and EMP_UI_TICKET tickets + TEST_TICKET_ATTACH ticket from backend_test. Test users were cleaned up at the end of the UI run; backend_test cleans up its own TEST_* data (assets/inventory/users). The two UI test tickets remain in the DB and were visible on the dashboard — can be purged if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 11 tests, all green). It covers setup-needed, auth, users (parc flag), upload+download roundtrip, inventory template+import+cleanup, assets CRUD+export, and ticket+attachment. For UI testing, use `logout-button` data-testid for logout (icon-only button in the header), and remember the ticket modal requires a category to be selected before 'Créer le ticket' succeeds.
